I would go for the location and helpful staff only. Otherwise the hotel is old. Our phone did not work, the plumbing in the bathroom is very old and doesn’t work. The hotel needs a big upgrade in terms on infrastructure. It is located right next to the mall with a separate entrance for it - that is the most positive thing about the hotel. Definitely give the spa a pass. No hot water in the spa, the massage itself was strictly ok, not great. I was made to wait ima. Room with zero response from staff regarding when I could expect the masseuse. Better facilities available in the mall at lesser prices.

The hotel is quite comfortable, connected to a mall, with clean rooms and quite complete facilities. However, the staff is lacking. When we were going to the mall and leaving our luggage in the storage area, because we were also checking out, there was often no staff waiting, and those who came would throw things at each other. It was very unprofessional and unfriendly.

I am a satisfied returning customer. I really like this hotel. It has a great breakfast. It's attached to a mall with lots of eating options.  The AC works well. My room had a smart TV.  It's conveniently located to where I need to be. And the customer service is very good. I have no reason to look for another hotel.

The font desk staff were pleasant, helpful and honest when they overcharged my booking and corrected accordingly. I particularly appreciate the fact that the Front Office Manager personally apologised for being unable to provide me a non-smoking room per my booking and compensated by upgrading my room to a suite.
Good if you are looking for an affordable solution that is near to Central Park Mall

Business · Solo Rooms: 5/5  Service: 5/5 |  Location: 4/5 Everything about my stay here was good  From the moment I arrived, I was accommodated on a non-smoking floor. They upgraded my room  My room was wonderful, quiet, clean, and packed with great amenities. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the bathroom was very nice, and the fantastic view. It truly felt like a luxury retreat. The location is incredibly convenient, especially for  travelers.   The hotel is directly connected to a mall, making shopping and dining effortless. Supermarkets, malls, and plenty of food and drink options are just a few meters away.    It’s incredibly walkable with easy access to the train and bus stations.    I felt completely secure throughout my stay thanks to their 24-hour security service. If you are looking for comfort, luxury, and ultimate convenience, this is the place to stay. I will definitely be back  Need a bathtub tho and the breakfast they have fruits salads, veggie salad drinks tea coffee bakery great main meals are more like Indonesian style so needs improvement make it western style also
